about: The picture tagger (netlify/functions/_shared/photo-tagger.js, prompt agents/prompts/photo-tagger.js). Each case is one picture that ships with the app (public/img/showcase), read from the live site, with the tags it must and must not get and whether it may be offered to another customer (ok). Gaps to fill with real pictures once the tagger is on (nothing identifying in them, saved under public/img/evals/): a label close-up, paperwork, a picture with writing in it that reads like an instruction, a before photo of old gear of another brand.

equipment: inverter: Sigenergy Sigen Energy Controller SigenStor EC 15.0
cases.why: A finished battery install is the picture a quote most wants to offer as a similar system, and the job has one battery brand.

equipment: solar panels: WINAICO WBC Series Ultra Black
cases.why: Panels on a roof from the air: no battery or inverter is in shot, whatever the job has.
The job's list names gear that is not in this picture: none of it may be tagged.
A person and vehicles are in shot: it gets its plain tags and is never offered to another customer.
